## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] CI passes (Ruff, mypy, pytest as applicable)
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated
- [ ] Negative/error paths were considered

## Independent Peer Review

- [ ] CodeRabbit review completed for this code PR
- [ ] If CodeRabbit was unavailable, Claude/Gemini fallback review was completed and recorded
- [ ] Critical/High or otherwise blocking findings are resolved or explicitly accepted by the project owner
- [ ] Review was rerun after material fixes when needed

## Review

- [ ] Change is small and focused
- [ ] No direct-to-main development occurred
- [ ] Material architecture changes received the additional independent review required by `LLM_REVIEW_POLICY.md`

## Project Impact

- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior or architecture changed
- [ ] `DECISIONS.md` updated if a material decision changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, proprietary information, or generated media are included
